description: This file defines the DeprecatedCallableInfo class within the Twig namespace, which is used to manage information about deprecated callables, including generating deprecation messages.

classes.name: DeprecatedCallableInfo
classes.description: A final class that holds information about deprecated callables in Twig and provides methods to set their type and name, as well as trigger deprecation warnings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for DeprecatedCallableInfo, initializing package, version, and optional alternate name, package, and version.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the deprecated callable.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the deprecated callable.

methods.name: triggerDeprecation
methods.description: Generates and triggers a deprecation warning message, optionally including file and line information.
